title: Anonymous whistleblower on crash retrieval team in northern Nevada
place_text: Northern Nevada desert (former Nevada Test Range), USA

tellings.quote: initial, he was on a crash retrieval team in the northern Nevada desert way north. Used to be called the Nevada Test Range. And about I think it was 2009, somewhere around there, he was on a team retrieving these objects.

plain: A man who has not been named says that around 2009 he served on a crash retrieval team, a group sent to recover crashed craft, working far out in the northern Nevada desert on land once called the Nevada Test Range. Steven Greer, who argues on the show that UFO secrets are held by a global cabal, tells Michels what this whistleblower told him. If it is true, such recoveries would still have been going on in recent years.
